description: Returns the business's status page link, where the person can tap 'Get alerts' to sign up themselves. Use this for TEXT alerts: text opt-in must be completed by the person on the web form, not by an agent. Text alerts may not be enabled yet.

handle.description: The business's handle: the last part of its status page URL (areweworking.org/{handle}), e.g. 'riverside-fab'. Use search_businesses if you only know the name.

name: get_alert_signup_link
title: Get the link to sign up for text or email alerts
